name: Bouquet Canyon Park
note: City of Santa Clarita park in Saugus (28127 Wellston Dr): 8 dedicated outdoor pickleball courts in one fenced pen (the city's count), two rows of four on what were two tennis courts, free and first come; the basketball court, the softball field, the playground and the restroom beside them, Bouquet Canyon Elementary next door.
_lit: no court lights: none show in the aerial (the softball field's poles do), OSM has no lit tag; the city's older listing says 'lighted tennis court' (owner question)
_anchor: the z20 aerial's anchor: en points are meters east/north of it

spawn._src: the park's lot east of the courts (OSM 995954595)

courts._drop: OSM's two 'pickleball' pitches are the two old tennis courts (37 x 18.5 m each); the aerial shows four pickleball courts on each, so the eight are placed from the aerial
courts._add: court centres traced off the Esri z20 aerial (two rows of four, long axis at bearing 170.4, 8.9 m apart in each old tennis court, 9.25 m across its middle, rows 18 m apart); they agree with OSM's two pitches within 3 m

_colors: sampled off the aerial (court and kitchen the same blue, a grey-green surround, black fence), lifted out of the aerial's haze by eye

fence._room: the pen in the aerial: about 39 m along the courts by 41 m across
fence._benches: nothing by rule: no benches, bleachers by the courts or pro-shop kiosk (none mapped, none in the aerial; a city park with no pro shop)

_props: OSM: the five picnic tables (leisure=picnic_table nodes) and the two bleachers by the softball field (leisure=bleachers)
